purpose: Preserve three reviewed traditional/Hong Kong forms that OpenCC STCharacters normalizes to another traditional form. This is not a blanket reversal of the simplified-character filter.

entries.reason: A normal traditional form used in Hong Kong Cantonese and traditional Mandarin; OpenCC's preferred variant does not make this spelling simplified-only.
A normal traditional form documented in the Chinese University of Hong Kong Cantonese character database and Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary.

A traditional variant and common Cantonese spelling documented alongside 曬 by the Chinese University of Hong Kong; also present in traditional Ministry of Education dictionary entries. Keep this spelling without replacing it with 曬.

data_reuse: Only reviewed character classifications and reference links are recorded. No dictionary definitions, pronunciations, or corpora are copied from the evidence websites. All character/code entries still come unchanged from the pinned MIT Cangjie source.
